temporal_notes: Larvae collected during the rainy season in June 2008.
coord_source_text: Yaokoffikro, a suburban village of Bouaké city in central Côte d’Ivoire, geo-referenced at 5°1’ W longitude and 7° 11’ N latitude.
source_text: During the rainy season in June 2008, larvae of An. gambiae s.s. were collected at the site and reared at IPR insectary for emergence and testing of adults.
